sources: MDC GIS Area_Feature_Layers/FeatureServer/27 'Camping Sites' and /26 'Parking Lots' (https://gisblue.mdc.mo.gov/arcgis/rest/services/Discover_Nature/Area_Feature_Layers/FeatureServer), queried within 3 km 2026-11-09
Esri World Imagery (leaf-off) 400 m frame around 40.4855,-92.6852, viewed 2026-11-09
note: Chariton River boat access beside the Highway 136 bridge east of Livonia. MDC lists designated camping here but marks no campsite on its area map or GIS; the only developed spot is the small paved loop lot at the ramp, where this pin sits, so expect to camp in the lot. --Claude
summary: Confirmed free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. No campsite can be located: the 2019 area map shows only the paved lot and concrete ramp, GIS has no camping point within 3 km, and imagery shows nothing but the paved loop lot. Pin is on that lot - kept. Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT (no site located): the area page lists 'Designated Camping Sites' under Things to Do, but the area map (4/1/2019) marks only a parking lot (P, accessible) and a concrete boat ramp, MDC's Camping Sites layer has no point within 3 km, and leaf-off imagery shows only a paved teardrop loop lot (~50 x 70 m with a small pull-in on its west side) straight off US 136, the ramp running north from it. Camping here is in practice in the ramp lot - a lot allowance in all but name (MDC still designates camping on the area, so it meets the stated MDC bar). A 23-ft rig reaches it on pavement off US 136. MDC's lot record says Surface 'Paved', Allows_Trailers 'No' (40.48458,-92.68528) - odd for a boat-ramp lot; reported as read.
Pin 40.48459,-92.68529 is on the paved lot (GIS lot point 1 m away) - kept; no camping spot to move it to.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront): confirmed. The lot sits ~25-60 m from the Chariton channel behind a wooded bank; no open apron. The area is 10.5 acres.
Note rewritten: generic MDC text (limit, 'site length not published') and directions dropped; the no-mapped-site caveat kept.

fees.source: https://mdc.mo.gov/discover-nature/activities/camping ('All camping on conservation areas is free'); the area page (https://mdc.mo.gov/discover-nature/places/archangel-access) lists no fee, read 2026-11-09
